title: Chapter 320 - 320 Suggestion; Go!
content:
Chapter 320 - 320 Suggestion; Go!

Chapter 320 - 320 Suggestion; Go!

320 Suggestion; Go!

“Oh right, there are no classes in the afternoon, right? I want to bring the whole class out to celebrate my invention of the super battery and the signing of the 1.5 billion contract.”

“What do you guys think?”

Originally, Song Yi was disappointed that he could not give Lin Fan a bear hug.

However, after hearing Lin Fan’s words, he became excited again.

“Alright!”

Lin Fan asked, “Do you have any recommendations?”

“Barbecue skewers and beer!” Song Yi said.

Lin Fan then looked at Ma Zhong.

Ma Zhong understood that he was asking for his opinion. He said, “…Hot pot?”

Sitting next to him, a round-faced man said, “I know a good barbecue restaurant!”

“Let’s eat seafood!”

“Let’s eat Sichuan cuisine and drink!”

Initially, it was only the students around Lin Fan who gave suggestions.

Soon, the other students in the class knew that Lin Fan was organizing a celebration in the afternoon.

Therefore, they all made suggestions.

Gradually, the entire classroom became extremely noisy.

At this moment, Zheng Jinbao, who had been silent all this while, said, “If you ask me, revisiting AC Clubhouse is the best idea! We can eat barbecue, hotpot, Sichuan cuisine, and drink alcohol there… We can even get a massage!”

As soon as he said this, the entire classroom suddenly fell silent.

Although the students did not voice out their agreement, Lin Fan understood that this silence was a tacit agreement.

“Alright, then we’ll go to AC Clubhouse later!”

Ma Zhong shook his buttocks and said, “We… We’re going to AC Clubhouse… Isn’t that a bad idea?”

At this moment, a melodious bell rang throughout the campus.

The old professor slowly walked in and began his lullaby-like lecture again.

Today was even more difficult.

Many of the students looked listless. From time to time, they would pull out their phones and secretly check the time, silently calculating how long it was until class ended.

As the bell rang again, all the students seemed to have been revived and were in high spirits.

All the students surrounded Lin Fan and said, “Brother Lin Fan, are we leaving now?”

Lin Fan, who had been woken up by the ringing, nodded his head in a daze.

At this moment, Counselor Sun Yaodong walked in. He smiled and said, “Students, you’re all still here. Have you planned where to celebrate?”

“AC Clubhouse,” Lin Fan replied honestly.

Sun Yaodong’s eyes lit up, but he said calmly, “AC Clubhouse? Alright, let’s go, then.”

All the students in the class were stunned.

Counselor Sun was joining them?

Although Sun Yaodong and the students usually shared a very harmonious relationship…

A teacher was a teacher…

Now, they were going to celebrate together?

Sun Yaodong saw that the students were not moving, so he asked, “Everyone, let’s go. Why are you all standing there?”

Then, he said, “Oh right, Lin Fan, how should we go later?”

“The bus should have arrived at the school by now,” Lin Fan said.

“Alright, then let’s hurry over.”

After saying that, Sun Yaodong took the lead.

The students looked at each other and followed behind.

Just as Lin Fan had said, a Mercedes-Benz bus had arrived at the parking lot.

Wang Shengli, the general manager of Flying Dragon Security Company, saw Lin Fan from afar and quickly came over to welcome him. He said respectfully, “Mr. Lin, this way, please.”

After getting onto the bus, Sun Yaodong praised, “This is my first time riding a Mercedes-Benz bus. The configuration is indeed different!”

“Oh right, Lin Fan, when did you start researching chemistry?”

“I haven’t studied it for long,” Lin Fan said.

In fact, it was not just that he had not studied it for a long time.

He had only studied it for an hour.

Of course, Lin Fan could not say that.

Otherwise, would he not be treated as a monster?

“You invented the super battery after a short period of research and got 1.5 billion? You’re too talented.”

Wang Shengli, who was sitting at the front, felt his heart skip a beat.

Recently, he had been reading news about Lin Fan’s invention of the super battery.

When Wang Shengli first saw the name ‘Lin Fan’, he immediately thought of his boss.

However, he did not dare to put the two together.

After all, in his impression, his boss was a godly tycoon who had a deep relationship with the supergiants such as Little Tanuki, Penguin, and Alphabet.

He probably did not have the energy to study batteries.

The result?

He was the one who invented it!

Not only was his boss rich, but he was also a scientist?

1.5 billion?

Sun Yaodong naturally did not pay attention to Wang Shengli’s inner thoughts. He continued, “Lin Fan, are you going to join the Chemistry Department?”

When the students on the bus heard this, they all pricked up their ears.

They had always been proud of being classmates with Lin Fan.

If Lin Fan suddenly went to another department, it would be a pity.

Lin Fan said, “The Mathematics Department is good enough. Why would I go to the Chemistry Department?”

Sun Yaodong heaved a sigh of relief and smiled. “That’s right! Our Mathematics Department has always been very good!”

Jiangbei University was not far from AC Clubhouse.

After chatting for a while, they soon arrived at their destination.

When the two long-legged beauties saw such a large group of people, they said in a very sweet voice, “Welcome to AC Clubhouse.”

Sun Yaodong looked at the thin clothes of the long-legged beauties and their snow-white long legs. He could not help but swallow his saliva and said, “Lin Fan, this place isn’t shady, right?”

Lin Fan said, “Don’t worry. This is a place for proper meals and massages. We’ve all been here before.”

“Oh, that’s good,” Sun Yaodong said.

However, Lin Fan could vaguely hear a hint of regret in his tone.

Was it an illusion?

Under the guidance of the beautiful attendants, everyone came to the banquet hall and sat down.

Not long after, abalone, king crab, Australian lobster, roasted suckling pig, top-grade steak, charred beef, small hot pot, bullfrog, sea urchin egg, spicy bullfrog… were all served.

Just as Zheng Jinbao said, there was seafood, barbecue, hotpot, Sichuan cuisine, and wine.

Everyone looked at the table full of delicious food and could not help but swallow their saliva.

At this time, Song Jiaxin picked up a bottle of wine and poured a glass. “Congratulations to Lin Fan for his invention of the super battery. Let us give you a toast!”

When Sun Yaodong and the other students heard this, they all raised their wine glasses.

“Lin Fan, congratulations on your invention of the super battery.”

“Congratulations!”

Lin Fan also picked up his wine glass and said, “Thank you, everyone.”

Then, everyone downed the wine in their glasses.

After a glass of wine, the atmosphere in the private room became even more heated.
